title: Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
Job Description – Full Stack AI Engineer

**Company:** Lynky Tech  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 Years of Full-Time Professional Experience  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** Coimbatore

About Lynky Tech

Lynky Tech is looking for skilled and experienced Full Stack AI Engineers to join our development team. We are seeking professionals with strong full-stack development knowledge and hands-on experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing scalable web applications, integrating AI-powered features, and building intelligent software solutions using modern technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications.
* Develop responsive frontend applications and robust backend services.
* Build and integrate AI-powered applications, chatbots, and automation solutions.
* Work with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI tools, and AI APIs.
* Develop AI-based features using Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks.
* Integrate REST APIs, third-party services, and AI models into applications.
* Work with databases, manage data, and optimize application performance.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and intelligent workflows.
* Test, debug, and optimize frontend, backend, and AI components.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, and project teams to deliver software solutions.
* Research and implement emerging technologies to improve existing products.

Required Skills

* Minimum 2 years of full-time professional experience in software development.
* Strong knowledge of frontend technologies such as React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong backend development knowledge using Python, Node.js, or similar technologies.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs and backend integrations.
* Good understanding of databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB.
* Practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
* Experience working with LLMs, AI APIs, and AI-powered application development.
* Understanding of Git, version control, and software development practices.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, and AI Agents.
* Knowledge of OpenAI APIs, Claude, Gemini, or other LLM platforms.
* Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
* Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Experience developing and deploying production-level AI applications.

Eligibility

* Minimum 2 years of full-time professional work experience is mandatory.
* Candidates must have hands-on experience in full-stack software development.
* Practical exposure to AI integration and Generative AI technologies is preferred.
* Candidates should have experience working on real-world software projects.
* Strong interest in building scalable, AI-powered software products.

Why Join Lynky Tech?

* Opportunity to work on real-world AI and full-stack software projects.
* Exposure to modern AI technologies, LLMs, and automation solutions.
* Work with an innovative and technology-driven development team.
* Opportunity to build scalable AI-powered products.
* Professional growth and continuous learning opportunities.

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Mobile Application Developer
description:
Lynky Tech – Now Hiring

Position : Full Stack Mobile Application Developer

Location: R.S. Puram, Coimbatore

Employment Type: Full-Time, In-Office

Reports To: Founder

Preference: Immediate Joiner

About Lynky Tech

Lynky Tech builds done-for-you AI automation systems and AI-first platforms for businesses across India and the UAE, from jewellery and manufacturing to real estate and services.

We work on clearly scoped, fixed-timeline engagements that deliver real value in weeks, not quarters. We are a small, founder-led team, so you will work directly with the founder from day one.

About the Role

You will build and deliver mobile applications for real clients across jewellery, manufacturing, education and real estate.

The role involves developing cross-platform mobile applications using React Native or Flutter, along with the backend systems that support them.

You will use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day. You are responsible for reviewing, testing and understanding everything you build before it is delivered.

You will work directly with the founder from our R.S. Puram, Coimbatore office.

A Typical Day

- Pick up tasks from the project board, discuss the approach with the founder and start development.

- Build app screens and workflows using AI coding tools, reviewing and refining the generated code.

- Develop or fix backend APIs, database queries, WhatsApp integrations and payment integrations.

- Test builds on real mobile devices and fix issues.

- Share test builds with the project coordinator or client.

- Prepare releases, including building, signing, uploading and tracking store or client feedback.

Key Responsibilities

- Build mobile applications using React Native or Flutter for Android and iOS, from requirements to Play Store and App Store release.

- Develop backend systems using Node.js or Python APIs with PostgreSQL or MongoDB.

- Implement authentication features such as OTP/password login, user roles and secure payment gateway integrations.

- Integrate WhatsApp Business API workflows, notifications, voice input and calling features.

- Build AI-powered features within applications, including LLM integrations, voice assistants and simple AI agents.

- Deploy and maintain production backends, manage environments, monitor applications and resolve post-launch issues.

- Work with the project coordinator, participate in client demonstrations when required and document technical workflows.

- Review all AI-generated code, test applications on real devices and ensure that everything delivered is properly understood and tested.

First 90 Days

Days 1–30

- Learn the technology stack, repositories and client projects.

- Deliver small fixes and features on live applications.

- Understand and complete the release process.

Days 31–60

- Own one feature from development to completion, covering both app and backend.

- Work with the founder for reviews.

- Handle client feedback directly.

Days 61–90

- Lead a small application or major module from initial requirements to store release.

- Take ownership of production support.

Requirements

- 1–3 years of experience in mobile application development.

- Must have successfully published or shipped mobile applications. Candidates should be ready to share their apps or source code.

- Strong knowledge of React Native or Flutter.

- Good knowledge of at least one backend language: Node.js or Python.

- Experience with PostgreSQL or MongoDB, REST APIs, Git and basic deployment.

- Regular use of AI coding tools, with the ability to review and verify generated code.

- Good communication skills in English and Tamil.

- Ability to communicate delays or challenges at an early stage.

- Must be based in Coimbatore or willing to relocate before joining.

Nice to Have

- Experience publishing applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

- Experience with WhatsApp Business API, payment gateways or voice integrations.

- Knowledge of LLM APIs, RAG or AI agents.

- Basic knowledge of Docker, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as AWS, Railway or Vercel.

This Role Is Not Suitable For Candidates Who

- Do not have any shipped mobile application or portfolio to demonstrate.

- Use AI-generated code without reading, understanding or testing it.

- Prefer working only on frontend or only on backend development.

- Are looking for a work-from-home opportunity.

Hiring Process

1. CV review and a short phone screening.

2. A short practical development task involving a small application and API. This is the main assessment for the role.

3. Final discussion with the founder, followed by a decision within a few days.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary based on the role and experience.

- Opportunity to work with modern AI and software technologies.

- Access to premium AI coding tools required for the role.

- Startup environment with a flat structure and direct access to the founder.

- Real ownership and responsibility for the applications you build.

- ESOPs and other long-term benefits for long-term employees.

- In-office work at R.S. Puram, Coimbatore, alongside the founder and team.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Role : Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / React)**  
**Experience: 10+ years**  
**Type: Full-time**   
**Location : Coimbatore**

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer with strong React and .NET skills and real experience with cloudbased, distributed systems. The key thing for us: you understand how the moving parts — queues, message buses, caches — actually work, not just how to publish and subscribe. When something breaks in production, we need someone who knows enough about what's happening under the hood to start digging and drive a root cause analysis.

What You'll Do  
**Build and maintain modern web applications with React and .NET / ASP.NET Core**  Design scalable backend services, REST APIs, and cloud-native solutions  
**Work with messaging and event-driven architectures**   
Apply sensible caching strategies to keep applications fast  
**Investigate production issues and lead root cause analysis**

**Required Skills**   
Frontend: React, JavaScript/TypeScript, component-based architecture, state management  
**Backend: .NET / ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, async programming, design patterns**   
Cloud: Azure, AWS, or GCP — designing and supporting distributed applications

**Messaging** — you should understand, not just use: Hands-on with at least one of Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or AWS SQS/SNS, and able to reason about how they work — pub/sub, fan-in/fan-out, retries, dead-letter queues, message ordering, at-least-once vs exactly-once delivery, and idempotency. You know why duplicate messages happen and how to prevent them.

**Caching** — strategy, not just usage: Redis or similar, with a grasp of the trade-offs — cache-aside, invalidation, expiration policies — and when each applies.

**Production troubleshooting:** Comfortable diagnosing messaging failures and performance bottlenecks through logs and monitoring, and running RCA on distributed systems.

**The Bar We're Setting**

We're not expecting deep, nitty-gritty distributed-systems expertise. We are looking for someone who knows enough about how these systems behave underneath to investigate confidently, ask the right questions, and get to the root cause — rather than someone who only knows the publish/subscribe surface.

**Nice to Have**  
Microservices · Docker & Kubernetes · CI/CD · DDD · Event Sourcing / CQRS · Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, or Prometheus

Experience 10+ years in full stack development, strong React and .NET, and a track record supporting cloud-based enterprise applications in production
